A scope for those who always hit their marks.
'Pick your target, get them in your sights, then shoot them dead.'

A clip that once caused a massive explosion over the night skies in Laterano.

一份为卡西米尔的骑士定下的戒律。 “诚实、坚定、勇敢、不屈。”: A list of commandments set by a Kazimierzian knight. 'Honesty. Dedication. Valor. Tenacity.'
一份属于迅捷之人的作战粮。\n“它的作用是提供能量，不是满足口腹之欲。”:
A combat ration for those always on the go.

一台属于不屈之人的弹射器。\n“它能让你在各个平台间快速移动，前提是你学会使用它:
A launcher for those who never give up.
'It'll let you jump between the platforms real quick. Just make sure you learn how to use it first, or you'll end up face-first in the dirt.'
一套彰显家族成员身份的正式着装。 “在这里，服装有言语不能说明的意义。”: A set of formalwear to showcase one's membership in a famiglia. 'Here, there are things that clothes can say and words cannot.'

'Face the enemies you must prevail over, and prove your superior strength.'

A grenade for those who carry out raids.
